channel.title: TalkKey Updates
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 2.19
item.description:
What's New in 2.19

  • The control bar is half the size — a genuinely tiny pill that stays out of the way
  • Fixed the square halo: the glow was being clipped by the window edge and showed hard corners
  • The chevron now opens quick settings instead of just collapsing: switch language (Auto / EN / RU or any other), change mode, jump to Dictionary or Settings
  • Fixed the transcript being typed into TalkKey itself if the app happened to be frontmost when a recording started

item.title: Version 2.18
item.description:
What's New in 2.18

  • One floating pill instead of two — the control bar is now the recording indicator, so the separate overlay is gone
  • Compact by default and centred at the bottom of the screen, no longer stuck in the far corner
  • It glows in the colour of the active mode while recording — red for paste, blue for translate, purple for review
  • Expands smoothly into waveform and timer when recording, then shrinks back
  • Denser, finer waveform
  • Fixed the bar remembering a wrong position and reappearing in the bottom-left corner on every launch

item.title: Version 2.17
item.description:
What's New in 2.17

  • Dictionary — teach TalkKey the words it keeps getting wrong: product names, people, technical terms. Terms are fed to the speech model before decoding and repaired in the text afterwards, so they come out right both ways
  • Optional "fix near-misses" repairs words that came out almost right, while leaving plurals and Russian case endings alone
  • Both the dictionary and the near-miss repair can be switched off independently
  • Floating control bar — start and stop dictation by clicking instead of holding a key, switch mode on the fly, jump to history. Toggle it from the menu bar (⌘B)
  • Click-to-record means long dictations no longer require holding the hotkey the whole time

item.title: Version 2.16
item.description:
What's New in 2.16

  • Brand-new app icon — a keycap with a glowing waveform, drawn as vector art and rendered natively at every size for crisp edges from the Dock down to 16px
  • Redesigned installer: the DMG now opens a proper styled window with a dark background, drag-to-Applications arrow and a custom volume icon
  • The installer disk image is now signed, notarized and stapled

item.title: Version 2.15
item.description:
What's New in 2.15

  • Your transcript is never lost: the text is always copied to the clipboard before pasting, so even if auto-paste fails you can just press ⌘V
  • New result card: when something goes wrong (too quiet, nothing recognized, paste failed, error) a small floating card explains what happened, shows your text and offers a Copy button
  • Fixed silent failures — error notifications never actually appeared because notification permission was never requested
  • Quiet recordings are rejected less aggressively

item.title: Version 2.14
item.description:
What's New in 2.14

  • Fixed auto-detect sometimes translating your speech instead of transcribing it — ambiguous recordings are now decoded with both candidate languages and the confident one wins
  • Fixed the iPhone (Continuity) microphone being grabbed after every restart — TalkKey now uses the System Default input unless you explicitly pick a device, and remembers your choice reliably
  • All-new full-size main window with a sidebar — Home, History and Settings like a proper desktop app

item.title: Version 2.13
item.description:
What's New in 2.13

  • Fixed a square halo around the recording overlay — the glow was clipping against the window edge

item.title: Version 2.12
item.description:
What's New in 2.12

  • Auto-detect language now works in Offline mode — speak any language without changing settings
  • Redesigned recording overlay: buttery-smooth waveform, recording timer, per-mode accent colors, gentle fade in/out
  • Major performance overhaul: the UI no longer re-renders 30× per second while recording — much lower CPU usage
  • Recording starts faster — removed a 100ms freeze when the hotkey is pressed
  • Smoother tab switching and status animations in the main window

item.title: Version 2.11
item.description:
What's New in 2.11

  • Fixed a crash on shutdown of the recording overlay introduced in 2.10
  • Retains all CPU/memory improvements from 2.10

item.title: Version 2.10
item.description:
What's New in 2.10

  • Fixed high CPU and memory usage caused by the recording overlay running animations in the background
  • Overlay window is now fully released when not recording — no more slowdown after long uptime

item.title: Version 2.9
item.description:
What's New in 2.9

  • Fixed progressive UI slowdown after multiple recordings
  • Recording overlay no longer lags over time — no restart needed
  • Improved memory management for audio buffers

item.title: Version 2.8
item.description:
What's New in 2.8

  • Multilingual auto-detect: speak in any language, TalkKey recognizes it automatically
  • Switch between languages mid-recording — no need to change settings
  • Existing users automatically migrated to Auto-detect mode

item.title: Version 2.7
item.description:
What's New in 2.7

  • Smooth waveform animation — throttled to 30fps with unified animation
  • No more visual glitches on M4 and other Apple Silicon

item.title: Version 2.6
item.description:
What's New in 2.6

  • Glass-style recording overlay with macOS vibrancy effect
  • New coral recording indicator (distinct from other apps)
  • Glowing pulse animation on recording dot

item.title: Version 2.5
item.description:
What's New in 2.5

  • Fixed waveform overflow in recording overlay
  • Smooth waveform animation restored

item.title: Version 2.4
item.description:
What's New in 2.4

  • Minimal recording overlay: clean pill with pulsing blue dot and waveform
  • Removed streaming text overlay for a distraction-free experience

item.title: Version 2.3
item.description:
What's New in 2.3

  • Fixed: previously downloaded models now correctly detected after update
  • Fixed: streaming transcription overlay now visible above recording bar
  • Fixed: model download reliability improved

item.title: Version 2.2
item.description:
What's New in 2.2

  • Tiny app size: speech model downloaded on first launch (3MB vs 450MB)
  • Choose your model: Turbo, Fast, Balanced, Accurate, or Most Accurate
  • Streaming transcription: real-time text in overlay while recording
  • Streaming text now appears above the recording bar
  • Menu-bar only app (no Dock icon)

item.title: Version 2.1
item.description:
What's New in 2.1

  • Streaming transcription: real-time partial text in overlay while recording
  • App is now menu-bar only (no Dock icon)
  • Improved audio engine for better WhisperKit integration

item.title: Version 2.0
item.description:
What's New in 2.0

  • Fixed Check for Updates button in Settings

item.title: Version 1.9
item.description:
What's New in 1.9

  • Added Check for Updates button in Settings
  • Dynamic version display from app bundle
  • Added GitHub link in About section

item.title: Version 1.8
item.description:
What's New in 1.8

  • Added automatic updates via Sparkle
  • Fixed translation feature for all languages
  • Improved microphone selection
  • Added silence detection to prevent transcription errors
  • Added microphone test feature
